contentList.content: Dark magic of the Underdark pulses in these threads. When an enemy becomes Enwebbed, its flesh is pierced by Virulent Venom and lit by the crimson Mark of Lolth for [1] turns.

This staff was forged for an ambitious priestess of Lolth who sought to outdo her sisters in the hunt for heretics. The metal web at its head is no mere ornament but a magical conduit: it drinks poison from a reservoir hidden within the shaft. It was said that its bearer walked the web as surely as the Spider Queen herself. Yet the priestess forgot that Lolth brooks no pride: soon she was caught in her own house's intrigues and found dead in her own webs. The staff passed to whoever proved cunning enough to claim it.
